extracted.name: 5 Ingredient 20 minute cookies
extracted.description: Well it is awesome I have made it multiple times in fact my fav way to eat it is to add chocolate chips caramel chocolate chips mini peppermint marshmallows coconut flakes and cinnamon yum
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups toppings (see above options in my notes)
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F
Beat sugar and butter together in a standing mixer until light and fluffier in texture. Gradually stir in flour until well combined. Fold In chocolate chips with standing mixer

Prepare two large baking sheets with parchment paper use your hands to make small/medium sized balls keep them 2 inches apart bake for 10 to 15 minutes always use the lowest time first this has been Remy
